name: FedoHud
author: Fedo
description: Alpha, not yet fully tested in-game. Custom HUD overlays: a small draggable in-game clock (HH:MM), hover tooltip lines showing how long until a planted crop is ready to harvest and until a beehive produces one more honey, and a floating "!" above a ready-to-harvest crop or a full beehive. Purely local, no network call involved.
